_comment: Copy the permissions block into ~/.claude/settings.json. Delete every key that starts with an underscore first. These rules ask before a remote, an upstream push or an edit in a synced folder. Change the two Edit paths to your own synced folders. The merge-ask and first-push-ask hooks ship with the chain plugin repo, not here.

_example_read_only_repo._comment: Example only. Put this block in <read-only-repo>/.claude/settings.local.json. It denies commits, pushes and pull requests there. Local edits for testing stay allowed. Use deny only for a rule with zero exceptions.
